description: Migrated legacy systems integration architectures to **scalable, cloud-native platforms**, improving **system reliability** across the university ecosystem.

Assisted in **CS 354 (C Programming and Computer Systems)**.

description: Assisted in **CS 540 (Introduction to AI)**
Guided **300+ undergraduate students** through core Artificial Intelligence concepts, including **machine learning, neural networks, search algorithms, and game theory.**
Debugged complex Python implementations during weekly office hours, helping students resolve **logical errors in search heuristics (A*, Minimax) and reinforcement learning models.**
Collaborated with professors and teaching assistants to evaluate student roadblocks and optimize course delivery for a large-enrollment foundational AI course.
Mentored diverse student teams during coding labs, fostering an inclusive environment that improved retention and confidence in computer science topics.
Designed and developed a **production-ready REST API** to expose NetApp’s core **RAID disk recommender engine**, enabling **cross-platform integration** and modernizing legacy workflow access.
Architected clean API endpoints with **strict payload validation**, transforming complex internal storage logic into structured, easy-to-consume **JSON/RESTful interfaces**.

Collaborated with the RAID core engineering team to deeply understand storage architectures (such as **RAID-4, RAID-DP, and RAID-TEC**) to ensure API parameters perfectly mapped to engine constraints.
Authored comprehensive **OpenAPI/Swagger documentation** and client integration guides, simplifying onboarding for internal NetApp developer teams.

**Led a team of two** to design and build an **automated disk provisioning system** on top of a deeply entrenched legacy RAID codebase, navigating tightly coupled subsystem dependencies to deliver a **race-condition-free**, production-safe implementation without destabilizing existing I/O paths.

Designed and implemented a **dynamic snapshot reserve scaling system** that auto-tuned reserve allocation based on workload patterns and resync topology, preserving snapshot coverage to **favor incremental resyncs over full parity reconstructions** and **reducing system downtime by 20%**.
Mapped critical RAID process dependencies and built **comprehensive test coverage** across the subsystem, strengthening the **reliability and resilience** of core storage operations.

Built **kernel snapshot/restore system** for AWS SageMaker Unified Studio, letting data scientists **persist and recover full Python session state** across kernel restarts without re-running notebooks.
Designed **fire-and-forget HTTP + WebSocket protocol** delivering **real-time per-variable progress** during large object serialization, **eliminating polling**.
Implemented **dual Zustand state machines** coordinating save/restore/retry/cancel across **9 async states** between REST and WebSocket events.
Built **race-condition-safe** interrupt-and-save/restore flow, sequencing kernel interrupts with snapshot ops under concurrent edge cases.
**Owned system end-to-end**: Python serialization backend, 7-endpoint REST/WebSocket API, and React/TypeScript UI with retry, cancel, and error alerting.
